description: This HTML file implements the front-end user interface for a database viewer web application. It contains the structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript logic to browse available databases, view tables, and display data with features like expandable cells and loading/error states.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for each table cell, handling special cases for objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
